sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The objective of the scheme is to provide hostel facilities to such disabled students who are taking admission in class 11th and above on a regular basis and in case hostel facilities are not available in the schools/colleges, by renting private buildings.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning
**Where it applies:** Madhya Pradesh; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Hostel Scheme for Disabled Students&quot; scheme was started by the Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 08.09.2008. The objective of the scheme is to provide hostel facilities to such disabled students who are taking admission in class 11th and above on a regular basis and in case of hostel facilities are not available in schools/colleges, by renting private buildings. Under this scheme, the expenditure on electricity and water in each hostel will be borne by the government at the rate of ₹1,000/- per month. If the expenditure is more than this, the additional amount will be borne equally by the students. Only house rent, electricity, and water tax shall be borne by the Social Justice Department. Utensils, equipment, furniture, ration, water, cleaning, newspaper, sweeper, etc. rest of the arrangements will have to be made by the students themselves. The Department has no liability for this.

**Benefits / Assistance:** Under the scheme, the following benefits are provided to the eligible students who are not getting hostel facility from schools/colleges: - **Rental Assistance:** Beneficiaries receive ₹750/- per month for renting a student home, the District Officer or Social Justice will approve. - **Utility Support:** Students are given ₹1,000/- per month to cover electricity and water charges for the student home. - **Rent Approval:** The District Collector approves a student home rent of up to ₹1,500/- per month.

**Application Process:** - Application in [prescribed format](https://socialjustice.mp.gov.in/uploads/files/Order__36(1).pdf) should be submitted to the District Office of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare. **Note 1:** The District Officer Social Justice will be authorized for competent approval. **Note 2:** After inspecting the house, the District Divisional Officer or the Principal will take into account the electricity, water, toilet, building in good condition, proximity to educational institutions, facility of the students etc.

**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Social Justice And Empowerment Of Persons With Disabilities Department, Government Of Madhya Pradesh; Nodal Department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
**Tags:** Hostel, Disabled Student, PwD, Higher Education, Rental Assistance
